headline: Thomas More stand alone at the top
dek: Thomas More beat Ohio Dominican on Thursday and lead the table on their own, after Lake Erie lost at Findlay. Thomas More have won six matches and lost two, both defeats coming before conference play opened. Tiffin, still unbeaten in conference play, are the only other side yet to lose one.
displaced_by: Lake Erie lost at Findlay; Thomas More lead the table alone.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are going short at the bottom of the table: Lake Erie's eighteen are more than Malone and Walsh have scored between them.

wire.line: Thomas More lead the table alone after Findlay end Lake Erie's unbeaten conference run.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have gone past their date with no published result. Kentucky Wesleyan account for most of them, and Walsh's visit to Pitt-Johnstown is the other.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tiffin have conceded five goals all season and have lost only once, at home to Charleston on the opening day; since then they have won four and drawn three.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Findlay have won six matches and lost one, away to Kentucky Wesleyan, and have conceded six goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ohio Dominican have conceded nineteen goals, and have won once, drawn twice and lost five times.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tom Woodward has scored five goals for Ashland from thirty-five shots.

last_match.line: Findlay's only defeat of the season came away to Kentucky Wesleyan; Lake Erie had been unbeaten in conference play until this.

next_match.line: Thomas More have yet to lose at home this season; Malone's win at Cedarville is their only conference victory.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
